select shf.id as fileId, bmte.cus_task_id as cusTaskId ,bmte.group_type as groupType,bmte.upload_time as uploadTime from stra_his_file shf left join b_marketing_task bmt on shf.batch_number = bmt.batch_number left join b_marketing_task_extend bmte on bmte.task_id = bmt.id WHERE shf.id in
#{fileId}

select shf.id, shf.api_code, shf.batch_number from stra_his_file shf inner join b_marketing_task bmt on shf.batch_number = bmt.batch_number where shf.api_code = #{apiCode} and shf.status = 2 and shf.type = 2 and date(shf.create_time) = #{scoreDate} and bmt.monitor_type = 1 order by shf.create_time desc limit 1

select shf.id, shf.api_code, shf.batch_number from stra_his_file shf inner join b_marketing_task bmt on shf.batch_number = bmt.batch_number inner join b_marketing_task_extend bmte on bmt.id = bmte.task_id where shf.api_code = #{apiCode} and shf.status = 2 and shf.type = 2 and bmte.data_condition like CONCAT('%', #{condition}, '%')
and bmt.monitor_type = 1 order by bmte.create_time desc limit 1
select bmte.data_condition from b_marketing_task bmt inner join b_marketing_task_extend bmte on bmt.id = bmte.task_id where bmt.batch_number = #{batchNumber}
select * from stra_his_file where api_code = #{apiCode} order by create_time desc limit 1
